text.arabic_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ كَمَا صَبَرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْعَزْمِ مِنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَلَا تَسْتَعْجِل لَّهُمْ ۚ كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ مَا يُوعَدُونَ لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا سَاعَةًۭ مِّن نَّهَارٍۭ ۚ بَلَٰغٌۭ ۚ فَهَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ

words.gloss_range: consequential connector turning prior judgment into a command-frame
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) opens the ayah as a consequence, not as a loose continuation. It draws the judgment scene of 46:34 into the present command {{ar:ٱصْبِرْ}} ({{tr:iṣbir}}), so prophetic endurance is the response demanded by what has just been shown. Because another {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) later opens the final question, the ayah is framed by consequence twice: first command, then verdict.

topics.headline: opening consequence frames command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the patience command is a conclusion drawn from the prior judgment scene (46:34), not a detached exhortation.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a consequential connector, and the CRITICAL rows converge on the opening particle as a discourse hinge that bookends the later closing particle.

words.gloss_range: singular Form I imperative of active endurance and restraint
words.root_gloss_range: root field of holding, binding, and persevering; locally selected as commanded self-restraint
words.prose: {{ar:ٱصْبِرْ}} ({{tr:iṣbir}}) is a singular imperative addressed to the Prophet, so the burden of endurance is personal and mission-facing. The root field makes patience active restraint rather than mere waiting, and the later prohibition {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) {{ar:تَسْتَعْجِلْ}} ({{tr:tastaʿjil}}) defines that restraint by forbidding the opposite impulse: seeking acceleration. The echo with {{ar:صَبَرَ}} ({{tr:ṣabara}}) makes the command lean on completed messenger precedent, while parallels such as 50:39, 40:55, and 52:48 keep it within a recurring prophetic endurance formula.

topics.headline: personal endurance command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that patience here is a singular, active holding of the mission steady, sharpened by the ban on hastening and grounded in earlier messengers' completed endurance.
topics.reason: QAC supports the 2ms Form I imperative; CRITICAL rows tie the form to singular address, root restraint, the haste antonym, intra-ayah echo, and prophetic command parallels.

words.gloss_range: comparison preposition measuring the command by an enacted precedent
words.prose: {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:ka}}) is the hinge that turns the command toward a model. It governs the following {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) clause, so the Prophet's endurance is calibrated by the way the resolve-bearing messengers endured. The comparison creates likeness without identity: the present addressee is measured against precedent, not replaced by it.

topics.headline: comparison to precedent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command receives a historical measuring-stick rather than remaining an abstract ideal.
topics.reason: The particle is parsed as a comparison preposition, and the rows agree that it scopes over the following clause as a model frame.

words.gloss_range: clausal slot after the comparison, with maṣdariyya and relative readings both contributing
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) supplies the content governed by {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:ka}}). As a maṣdariyya reading, it points to the manner of their patience; as a relative reading, it can also point to what they endured. The local payoff is that the comparison carries both mode and burden without forcing the ayah to name either separately.

topics.headline: comparison content keeps manner and burden in view
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the comparison can route the command toward how the earlier messengers endured and toward what they endured.
topics.reason: QAC favors maṣdariyya, while the CRITICAL rows preserve the relative possibility; the output therefore keeps both as a local ambiguity without making the relative reading control the parse.

words.gloss_range: perfect Form I verb presenting prior endurance as completed precedent
words.root_gloss_range: same root as the command, locally presenting completed restraint
words.prose: {{ar:صَبَرَ}} ({{tr:ṣabara}}) answers {{ar:ٱصْبِرْ}} ({{tr:iṣbir}}) with the same root in the perfect. The command is therefore not unsupported; what is now demanded has already been accomplished by the model group. The pre-subject singular verb lets the completed act be heard before {{ar:أُو۟لُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʾulū}}) {{ar:ٱلْعَزْمِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿazm}}), making endurance the criterion before the title is fully named.

topics.headline: completed patience grounds the command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the temporal loop: present commanded patience is authorized by past completed patience.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a perfect Form I verb with the following subject; CRITICAL rows preserve tense, VSO order, root echo, and sound linkage.

words.gloss_range: nominative construct plural of possessors, requiring the following quality
words.root_gloss_range: possessor-form field; locally classifying messengers by what they bear
words.prose: {{ar:أُو۟لُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʾulū}}) is a marked irregular construct plural meaning possessors, not an ordinary descriptive adjective, and it cannot stand alone. It requires {{ar:ٱلْعَزْمِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿazm}}), making resolve the defining possession rather than an added adjective. Its delayed subject position after {{ar:صَبَرَ}} ({{tr:ṣabara}}) lets the act of endurance come first, then identifies the actors by the quality they bear.

topics.headline: resolve as possessed identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the model group is defined as bearers of resolve, not merely as messengers who once acted resolutely.
topics.reason: QAC supports nominative construct status; CRITICAL rows emphasize possession semantics, delayed subject role, high-register form, and messenger-class linkage.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive gerund completing the possessor title
words.root_gloss_range: resolve, decision, and firm intention; locally a class-defining quality that severs hesitation
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَزْمِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿazm}}) completes the construct {{ar:أُو۟لُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʾulū}}) and is definite, so the phrase names recognized resolve rather than some vague firmness. The root imagery of decisive cutting and inner sinew makes the quality structural: hesitation is severed and the heart is braced. Because the term is rare and repeatedly joins endurance contexts such as 31:17, 42:43, and 3:186, its appearance here gives the messenger model unusual weight.

topics.headline: recognized resolve that cuts hesitation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that resolve is the possessed, class-defining quality of the model messengers, with a concrete image of firmness rather than a generic virtue label.
topics.reason: QAC marks genitive gerund after the construct; CRITICAL rows support definiteness, gerundal quality, root imagery, rarity, and patience-context parallels.

words.gloss_range: preposition specifying or partitioning the messenger class
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) locates the resolve-bearers within {{ar:ٱلرُّسُلِ}} ({{tr:al-rusul}}). The strongest local reading is partitive, making the model a distinguished subset from among the messengers, while the explanatory possibility still lets messengerhood as a whole be colored by resolve. Its later counterpart {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) partitions time, so the ayah uses the same small particle to select exemplary agents and then reduce duration.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the model may be a selected group from among the messengers, while the grammar also leaves an explanatory reading in view.
topics.reason: QAC labels the particle partitive; CRITICAL rows preserve the bayāniyya/tabʿīḍiyya tension, so the output narrows to partitive as primary without erasing the grammatical alternative.

words.gloss_range: definite broken plural naming the established messenger class
words.root_gloss_range: sending and commissioned movement; locally the class from which the resolve-bearers are specified
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلرُّسُلِ}} ({{tr:al-rusul}}) names the recognized class of messengers and is governed by {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}). Its broken plural form gives the class inherited collective weight, while the sending-root keeps their endurance mission-directed: these are not merely patient people but commissioned senders whose delivery duty is at stake. The word also prepares {{ar:بَلَٰغٌ}} ({{tr:balāghun}}), since messenger identity and final proclamation belong to one transmission field echoed from 46:23 into the surah close.

topics.headline: messenger class tied to delivery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the model is not generic piety; it is messenger endurance inside a mission of sending and delivery that culminates in proclamation.
topics.reason: QAC gives definite genitive plural after the preposition; CRITICAL rows support broken plural weight, sending semantics, 46:23 linkage, and b-l-gh/r-s-l co-occurrence.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining positive command to negative prohibition
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins the prohibition to the opening command. Patience and non-hastening are therefore one two-sided discipline: endure, and do not seek to accelerate the outcome. The short {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) turn also makes the movement from model to restraint audible before the jussive verb arrives.

topics.headline: command and prohibition coordinated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that non-hastening is not a separate afterthought but the negative side of the same patience command.
topics.reason: QAC identifies coordination with the following prohibition; CRITICAL rows tie the particle to the ṣabr/haste opposition and the audible reset before the clipped jussive.

words.gloss_range: prohibitive particle governing the jussive, not simple negation
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is prohibitive. It turns {{ar:تَسْتَعْجِلْ}} ({{tr:tastaʿjil}}) into a negative command and shows that patience is defined not only by what the Prophet must do but by the timing-pressure he must refuse. The particle starts a clipped prohibition whose grammar and pacing both curb the urge to rush.

topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as jussive/prohibitive; CRITICAL rows align on lā al-nāhiya, positive-negative command balance, and prosodic curtailment.

words.gloss_range: Form X jussive verb: do not seek or demand acceleration
words.root_gloss_range: haste and quickness; locally narrowed to volitional seeking of acceleration
words.prose: {{ar:تَسْتَعْجِلْ}} ({{tr:tastaʿjil}}) is Form X in the jussive after {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}), so the clipped mood belongs to prohibition rather than description. The form does not merely mean to be quick; it means to seek or demand acceleration, with the direct object left unstated and the concern routed through {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}). That makes the prohibition broad enough to cover rushing punishment, relief, or outcome, while the ṣ-b-r/ʿ-j-l contrast defines active patience as refusal to pressure divine timing; parallels such as 10:11 and 21:37 show the same impatience-with-timing field.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the party concerning whom haste is forbidden
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) binds the haste prohibition to {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) without naming the thing being hastened. It can sound like for them or concerning them, so the emotional target remains open: punishment for opponents, relief for followers, or the outcome assigned to the group. The prepositional phrase foregrounds the affected party more than the omitted object.

words.gloss_range: attached plural pronoun with definite form and context-open referent
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) is definite in form but its antecedent is not named inside the ayah. The nearest boundary context points back to the condemned disbelievers in 46:34, while the grammar can also broaden the concern. Its immediate repetition inside {{ar:كَأَنَّ}} ({{tr:kaʾanna}}) carries the same group from the haste prohibition into the time-compression scene.

topics.headline: contextual them carried into time collapse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a terse pronoun chain links the group of the prohibition to the group who will experience time collapse.

words.gloss_range: emphatic simile particle governing the time-compression clause
words.prose: {{ar:كَأَنَّ}} ({{tr:kaʾanna}}) opens the ayah's long time-compression frame. It governs the attached pronoun as subject and the {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) {{ar:يَلْبَثُوا}} ({{tr:yalbathū}}) {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) {{ar:سَاعَةً}} ({{tr:sāʿatan}}) predicate as an emphatic simile, not a loose hypothetical: when they see what was promised, it will strongly seem as though they had stayed only a brief span. This is the second comparison in the ayah; the first raises the Prophet toward messenger precedent, while this one reduces the disbelievers' lived time to an hour.

topics.headline: second comparison creates time collapse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that comparison drives both halves of the ayah: prophetic endurance is measured upward, while the opponents' worldly duration is shrunk downward.
topics.reason: QAC supports kaʾanna as an inna-like simile particle; CRITICAL rows preserve governed syntax, assertive likeness, doubled comparison with word 3, and the 46:34 boundary shift from courtroom scene to perception.

words.gloss_range: accusative temporal container for seeing the promised outcome
words.root_gloss_range: day, occasion, and eschatological Day; locally the decisive Day that remeasures ordinary time
words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمَ}} ({{tr:yawma}}) sets the decisive temporal container for {{ar:يَرَوْنَ}} ({{tr:yarawna}}) {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) {{ar:يُوعَدُونَ}} ({{tr:yūʿadūna}}), whose imperfect verbs make the future scene feel unfolding. The ordinary word for a day is pulled into the eschatological Day, then set against {{ar:سَاعَةً}} ({{tr:sāʿatan}}) {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) {{ar:نَهَارٍ}} ({{tr:nahārin}}), so the great Day makes prior days collapse into a daylight fragment. It also resumes the judgment-day horizon of 46:34, now reframed as perception rather than presentation.

topics.headline: the Day remeasures time

words.gloss_range: imperfect plural seeing as vivid future recognition
words.root_gloss_range: seeing by eye and realization by knowledge; locally both perception and recognition
words.prose: {{ar:يَرَوْنَ}} ({{tr:yarawna}}) makes the future scene vivid as an unfolding act. The root range lets seeing be both visual perception and cognitive realization: the group does not merely look at an event; they recognize the reality of what had been promised. Surah-level seeing reverses here, since earlier the messenger sees the people in 46:23, but now they see the consequence.

words.gloss_range: relative object packaging the promised content without naming it
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is the object slot for {{ar:يَرَوْنَ}} ({{tr:yarawna}}) and introduces {{ar:يُوعَدُونَ}} ({{tr:yūʿadūna}}). By saying what they are promised rather than naming the object, the ayah keeps the content compact and context-supplied. Attention falls on fulfillment itself: the unspecified promise or threat becomes seen reality.

words.gloss_range: passive imperfect of promise or threat, with agent suppressed
words.root_gloss_range: promise, threat, and appointed outcome; locally the awaited content they finally see
words.prose: {{ar:يُوعَدُونَ}} ({{tr:yūʿadūna}}) is passive, so the promiser is not named while the promised outcome feels already assigned. The group actively {{ar:يَرَوْنَ}} ({{tr:yarawna}}), but they passively receive what they were promised, and the root range keeps promise and threat available according to who {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) refers to. In the 46:34 boundary context, the warning side is prominent, but the grammar still leaves the formula broad enough to carry hope or dread in other referent construals.

words.gloss_range: lam of negated past governing a jussive verb
words.prose: {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) shifts the simile into retrospective negation: from the future Day, their worldly stay is viewed as something that had not lasted. Together with {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}), it begins the negation-exception mechanism that erases every longer duration and leaves only the small remnant named by {{ar:سَاعَةً}} ({{tr:sāʿatan}}).

words.gloss_range: jussive imperfect of remaining, negated into time-collapse
words.root_gloss_range: remaining or tarrying; locally the concept of extended stay is canceled
words.prose: {{ar:يَلْبَثُوا}} ({{tr:yalbathū}}) is the verb for remaining or tarrying, but under {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) it is negated and clipped in jussive form. The word that would name duration is used to undo duration, then {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) allows only a minimal residue. The formula {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) {{ar:يَلْبَثُوا}} ({{tr:yalbathū}}) {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) recurs in eschatological brevity passages such as 10:45, 30:55, and 79:46.

words.gloss_range: exception particle completing negation into exclusive time restriction

Its second occurrence at word 30 repeats the same narrowing operation, first on time and then on destruction.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative hour as the sole surviving duration
words.root_gloss_range: hour, moment, and eschatological Hour field; locally a small unspecified daylight span
words.prose: {{ar:سَاعَةً}} ({{tr:sāʿatan}}) is indefinite and accusative, the one duration left by {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}). words.gloss_range: isolated nominative gerundal proclamation; a terse nominal sentence
words.root_gloss_range: reaching, arriving, delivering, and sufficiency; locally completed communicative delivery
words.prose: {{ar:بَلَٰغٌ}} ({{tr:balāghun}}) stands as a one-word nominal declaration: this is proclamation. words.prose: {{ar:يُهْلَكُ}} ({{tr:yuhlaku}}) is singular because its passive subject is the singular collective {{ar:ٱلْقَوْمُ}} ({{tr:al-qawmu}}). topics.headline: caused ruin with suppressed agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final verdict foregrounds the destroyed class while still preserving caused destruction through the passive Form IV shape.
topics.reason: QAC supports singular Form IV passive with the following collective passive subject; CRITICAL rows preserve agent suppression, h-l-k range, qiraat voice/case pressure, formula parallel with 6:47, destroyed-peoples field, and rarity.

words.gloss_range: second exception particle restricting destruction to the final moral class
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) is the logical gate of the final verdict. After {{ar:هَلْ}} ({{tr:hal}}) {{ar:يُهْلَكُ}} ({{tr:yuhlaku}}), it excludes every class except {{ar:ٱلْقَوْمُ}} ({{tr:al-qawmu}}) {{ar:ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ}} ({{tr:al-fāsiqūna}}). This reprises the earlier {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}): the ayah first restricts duration to an hour, then restricts destruction to the fāsiq people.

topics.headline: only the named class is destroyed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's double restriction: minimal time and targeted destruction are built by the same exception logic.
topics.reason: QAC marks the second exception particle; CRITICAL rows support rhetorical qaṣr, reprise of the first illā, and the movement from 46:34's concrete sentence to a generalized rule.

words.gloss_range: definite singular collective serving as passive subject and narrowed by the final adjective
words.root_gloss_range: standing, rising, and people as a corporate body; locally a standing collective brought under ruin
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقَوْمُ}} ({{tr:al-qawmu}}) is definite, singular in form, and collective in meaning. In the standard passive reading it is the subject affected by {{ar:يُهْلَكُ}} ({{tr:yuhlaku}}), so the destroyed people are foregrounded as one corporate body; the standing-root image makes that ruin feel like the collapse of a standing social order. The following {{ar:ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ}} ({{tr:al-fāsiqūna}}) locks the moral label onto that body, while qawm scenes in 46:21, 46:23, and 46:25 return here as a closing category of peoples brought to ruin.

topics.headline: standing collective under verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict targets a corporate people, grammatically foregrounded as the affected subject, with ruin pictured as the collapse of a standing social order and morally narrowed by the final adjective.
topics.reason: QAC supports nominative passive subject; CRITICAL rows preserve definiteness, collective singularity, standing-root image, h-l-k/qawm and qawm/fisq pairings, 46:25 and same-surah people-scenes, and variant case pressure.

words.gloss_range: definite nominative active participle sealing the people as a known deviant class
words.root_gloss_range: going out, boundary-breaking, and moral deviation; locally an ongoing class attribute explaining liability to destruction
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ}} ({{tr:al-fāsiqūna}}) is the final word of the surah and the adjective that seals {{ar:ٱلْقَوْمُ}} ({{tr:al-qawmu}}). As a definite active participle, it names a recognizable class marked by ongoing boundary-breaking, not a one-time act. The date-skin rupture image gives fisq a concrete texture: a group breaks out of the frame meant to hold upright conduct. The parallel formula in 6:47 ends with the wrongdoing people, but here the final diagnostic is boundary rupture; it also answers 46:20, where the same root explains punishment before becoming the surah's closing class label.

topics.headline: boundary-breaking class closes the surah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the surah's last word gives the reason destruction is restricted: an ongoing class of boundary-breaking deviation.
topics.reason: QAC supports definite nominative active participle modifying the people; CRITICAL rows preserve agreement, participial ongoing force, fisq root image, 6:47 contrast, 46:20 echo, final-word closure, and command-to-verdict frame.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled patience root, the possessors of resolve, the messengers, the ban on hastening, and the standalone proclamation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The imperative and its messenger exemplar form a control loop: contain reactive distress, bind intention to the charge, keep a deliberate messenger pace, refuse premature acceleration, and continue until delivery.

activation_trace.role: Inward restraint against panic supplies the control that blocks reactive acceleration.
Decisive binding of the heart supplies fixed intention beneath that restraint.
Gentleness and deliberation give the messenger's movement its proper pace.
Speeding and bringing forward identify the pressure explicitly refused.
Carrying a message to its addressee makes faithful delivery, rather than scheduling, the work that remains.

changed_reading.before: Patience is passive endurance while waiting for punishment to arrive.
changed_reading.after: Patience is disciplined custody of a commission: restrain reactive urgency, keep intention fixed, preserve a deliberate messenger pace, and complete delivery without taking control of the timetable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The day of seeing the promise, the denial of a long stay, the daylight fraction, and the proclamation that has reached its limit.
baseline_models.mechanism: A scheduled and even countable promise becomes visible at its endpoint; arrival then makes the preceding residence contract in retrospect to a bounded fragment of daylight.

activation_trace.role: A stretch of time supplies the scale later subjected to retrospective compression.
Seeing by eye and insight marks the point when the latent endpoint becomes undeniable.
A promise fixed to a time or place makes the endpoint scheduled rather than indefinite.
The split mapped inventory contributes counting, making the promised interval measurable rather than amorphous.
Residence in a place supplies the duration that is later judged negligible.
The opening span of daylight bounds the comparison by a visible daily interval.
Arrival at a limit closes the interval and enables its backward rescaling.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts a long worldly wait with a short remembered stay.
changed_reading.after: The visible endpoint reorganizes temporal scale: once the scheduled promise arrives, the whole inhabited interval registers as scarcely a daylight fraction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The messengers, the proclamation, and the final restriction of destruction to the transgressing people.
baseline_models.mechanism: The message is sent and brought through to completion; the closing question then separates completed transmission from the communal rupture that culminates in loss.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and message supply the commission whose completion must be distinguished from its reception.
Delivery supplies a terminal marker for the messenger's responsibility.
A human collective makes the consequence social rather than an isolated accident.
A fruit breaking out of its shell supplies a material image of enacted departure from a containing order.
Collapse into loss and extinction supplies the endpoint of that departure.

changed_reading.before: The ending simply announces that a wicked group will be destroyed.
changed_reading.after: The ending closes the transmission contract and locates loss beyond it: delivery is completed, while destruction is restricted to a collective whose persistent action ruptures its containing order.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative to persist and the isolated proclamation after the compressed account of residence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside the delivery reading, the proclamation can activate sufficiency: enough provision is present to traverse the remaining stay, so patience is sustained passage rather than empty postponement.

activation_trace.role: Sufficiency one can live on recasts the isolated noun as enough provision for passage.
Bearing surety and remaining alongside others adds accountable accompaniment to endurance.
Continued residence supplies the span through which that sufficiency must carry the reader.

changed_reading.before: The isolated proclamation labels only a public announcement.
changed_reading.after: It can also name sufficiency: the verse gives enough orientation to carry the remaining stay without forcing its endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context turns duration into staged maturation: creation has an appointed limit, burden develops internally, maturity is reached, passage occurs degree by degree, and settlement is completed without deficit.

activation_trace.role: A temporal span is the focus interval whose apparent length is being re-evaluated.
Residence anchors the interval in lived duration rather than abstract chronology.
Reaching a limit supplies the terminal logic already latent in the focus.
A fixed end of a measured term makes the wait bounded from the outset.
Inner bearing and fruit supply an embodied process that remains hidden while it develops.
Repeated arrival at maturity makes attainment developmental rather than merely punctual.
Movement one degree at a time supplies ordered stages between beginning and settlement.
Full completion without shortage supplies the non-arbitrary finish of the process.

structural_cues: 46:3 pairs creation in truth with a named term; 46:15 measures bearing and repeated maturity; 46:19 places graded outcomes before complete repayment.
The repeated attainment in 46:15 gives the focus proclamation an embodied growth clock as well as a deadline.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed term, inner bearing, repeated attainment, graded passage, and full completion; I infer that these stages explain why non-haste can be purposeful maturation. A live alternative is that they are parallel temporal examples rather than one causal schedule.

changed_reading.before: Patience fills an unexplained delay before an externally imposed endpoint.
changed_reading.after: Patience inhabits an appointed maturation: much of the process is internally borne and traversed by degrees before it reaches a fully settled limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following revelation, warning, and delivering are assigned to the messenger; knowledge of timing is not. The opponents' demand for the threatened event and their later acceleration pressure the messenger to cross that boundary, so patience preserves jurisdiction as well as composure.

activation_trace.role: Self-restraint anchors the focus response to pressure.
The messenger role anchors what the addressee is actually charged to do.
Acceleration names the boundary-crossing impulse prohibited in the focus.
Following behind a given lead supplies the messenger's derivative rather than controlling position.
A divinely given report supplies the content that determines the messenger's course.
Warning that awakens caution defines the effect sought from delivery.
A threatened promise supplies the event opponents demand be produced on cue.
Knowledge as disclosure to a knower marks information the messenger explicitly does not possess independently.
Delivering a message identifies the positive task that remains within the messenger's charge.
Being sent with a message binds delivery to prior commission rather than personal control.
The opponents' own acceleration exposes the social pressure behind the focus prohibition.

structural_cues: 46:22 demands production of the threatened event; 46:23 answers by separating hidden timing knowledge from message delivery; 46:24 calls the arrival what they accelerated.
46:9 had already limited the messenger to following what is given and warning plainly.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following, revelation, warning, a demanded threat, withheld timing knowledge, commissioned delivery, and opponent-driven acceleration; I infer that the prohibition guards a role boundary. It may alternatively be pastoral restraint without a jurisdictional claim.

changed_reading.before: Do not wish that their punishment would arrive quickly.
changed_reading.after: Do not let their challenge recruit you into controlling the schedule: patient faithfulness means transmitting and warning while refusing ownership of when the threatened event arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The approaching phenomenon is genuinely seen but wrongly read as beneficial rain; it is the very event they accelerated. Destruction leaves residences as visible residue, and the later public display fixes the truth. Seeing in the focus therefore includes correction of prior interpretation, not merely first visual contact.

activation_trace.role: Visual and inward seeing anchors the focus moment of recognition.
Refused acceleration anchors the relation between premature demand and failed interpretation.
Actual eyesight establishes that perceptual access alone does not guarantee a correct reading.
Something appearing from one side supplies an ambiguous approach whose identity must be interpreted.
Water descending from cloud supplies the expected relief projected onto the approach.
Punitive descent from cloud reverses the same rain image into the arriving threat.
Their acceleration makes the misread arrival answer their own demand.
Root-level eradication supplies the actual effect hidden by the rain expectation.
The narrowed field of what remains visible supplies a second, corrected act of seeing.
Inhabited dwellings become residue, reversing a place of settled life into evidence of absence.
Public exposure to view supplies the terminal correction of disputed reality.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies what the corrected sight must finally acknowledge.

structural_cues: 46:24 moves from sight to a confident but false rain reading and immediately reverses it into the accelerated threat.
46:25 reduces the visible scene to dwellings, while 46:34 stages explicit exposure and acknowledgment just before the focus verse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sight, an ambiguous approach, expected and punitive rain branches, accelerated demand, erasure, residue, and final exposure; I infer that the focus seeing is interpretive correction. The live alternative is a separate end-time seeing with only analogical support from the earlier scene.

changed_reading.before: On the final day they will see the promised event for the first time.
changed_reading.after: The final seeing is a correction after mis-seeing: what had looked like relief can prove to be the very outcome they forced forward, and only the terminal exposure stabilizes its meaning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies hearing and sight capable of understanding, denial despite knowledge, repeated transformation of signs toward return, and destruction when return fails. The shell-exit image in the focus becomes a trajectory of refused reversibility rather than a static group label.

activation_trace.role: Breaking out of a shell supplies the focus image of enacted departure.
Collapse and extinction supply the terminal state whose selectivity the focus questions.
The repeated shell-exit image ties the final category to conduct already named in context.
Hearing as comprehension and compliance supplies a capacity that could have supported return.
Inward discernment supplies another available capacity, not merely an external organ.
Denial while knowing makes non-return active rather than informationally innocent.
A manifest marker supplies the evidence repeatedly available to perception.
Historical collapse supplies the realized endpoint of the trajectory.
Turning material from state to state supplies repeated variation intended to reopen response.
Returning from a wrong course supplies the reversible alternative offered before collapse.

structural_cues: 46:26 lists receptive faculties before saying they did not benefit; 46:27 states that signs were repeatedly varied so that return might occur.
The focus restriction to the transgressing people follows this failed return sequence rather than introducing an unprepared label.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies capacities for understanding, knowledgeable denial, varied signs aimed at return, and realized destruction; I infer a remedial sequence exhausted before collapse. The alternative is looser juxtaposition rather than a strict procedural threshold.

changed_reading.before: The transgressing people are a fixed condemned class to whom destruction simply applies.
changed_reading.after: Transgression names an enacted exit after available return is repeatedly reopened; destruction is the terminal state of refusing that reversibility, not the first move.

context_deltas.mechanism: The listeners hear with comprehension, become attentively silent, wait until the recitation is complete, orient themselves back toward their people, warn, identify an extended path, and call for response. Patience governs the order of action; it does not abolish urgency after reception is complete.

activation_trace.role: Restraint supplies the capacity not to interrupt or act before reception is complete.
Message-bearing anchors the later relay in the same communicative domain as the focus messengers.
Rejected acceleration distinguishes premature action from prompt action at the proper stage.
Hearing that includes understanding and compliance begins the ordered response.
Attentive silence supplies deliberate non-interruption while meaning is still arriving.
Completion and coming to an end supply the threshold after which movement becomes timely.
Turning the face toward a destination supplies directed return after completion.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the urgent purpose of their return.
An extended route supplies the durable course to which the warning directs its hearers.
Answering speech supplies prompt response once listening and relay have done their work.

structural_cues: 46:29 explicitly orders hearing, silence, completion, turning, and warning; 46:31 then commands response.
The sequence places restraint before completion and urgency after it, preventing both interruption and inert delay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies comprehension, attentive silence, completion, directed return, warning, route, and response; I infer that the focus patience regulates sequence rather than speed in the abstract. The alternative is that the scene models listening etiquette without defining the final imperative.

changed_reading.before: Patience and urgency are opposites, so patient action must be slow.
changed_reading.after: Patience is sequence discipline: do not speak or act before reception is complete, but once it is complete, turn, warn, and seek response without delay.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate lead-in denies fatigue in creation, affirms effective capacity to revive the dead, then stages public exposure and lived encounter with reality. The delay behind the focus patience is therefore not exhausted capacity; the endpoint changes knowledge from disputed report to experienced fact.

activation_trace.role: Seeing anchors the focus transition from promised report to undeniable encounter.
Residence supplies the duration retrospectively compressed by that encounter.
Bodily weariness, explicitly negated, removes depleted effort as the cause of delay.
Effective power that reaches action supplies assured ability to produce the endpoint.
Loss of life supplies the state that effective power is asserted able to reverse.
Exposure before view changes an absent claim into an immediate presented reality.
Stable fit with reality supplies the truth acknowledged under exposure.
Experiential testing supplies a stronger mode of knowing than prior verbal notice.

structural_cues: 46:33 asks about creation, fatigue, and revival; 46:34 immediately shifts to exposure, acknowledgment, and experience; 46:35 begins with a consequential therefore.
This adjacency grounds the patience command in demonstrated capacity before it asks the reader to endure apparent delay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated fatigue, effective power, reversible death, exposure, truth, and experience; I infer that delay is not incapacity and that temporal compression is partly epistemic. The alternative is that 46:33-34 establish doctrine without explaining the timing of 46:35.

changed_reading.before: Patience compensates for uncertainty about whether the promised endpoint can occur.
changed_reading.after: Patience follows from unwearied capacity: uncertainty lies in present access and timing, not ability, and the endpoint converts reported truth into exposure and experience that collapse the felt interval.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same promise root opens hope in the accepted trajectory and threat in the defiant trajectory; full repayment and the focus restriction on destruction preserve the asymmetry. The promised horizon can therefore sort responses rather than denote one undifferentiated catastrophe.

activation_trace.role: A verbal promise that opens hope preserves a beneficial side of the focus horizon.
A threatening promise preserves the punitive side carried by the same root.
Exit from a containing shell limits destructive fulfillment to an enacted trajectory.
Hope opened by a promised good supplies the accepted trajectory's future orientation.
Complete payment without shortage supplies equitable differentiation among trajectories.
The earlier shell-exit occurrence ties punitive fulfillment to practiced departure.
The demanded threat supplies the defiant trajectory's relation to the same promised horizon.

structural_cues: 46:16 frames promise as truthful good for accepted action, while 46:22 demands the threatened promise and 46:20 links punishment with practiced transgression.
The focus closes with an exception restricting destruction rather than universalizing it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hopeful promise, complete repayment, practiced shell-exit, and demanded threat; I infer one horizon differentiated by response. The live alternative is that the focus pronoun refers narrowly to opponents and only to punishment.

changed_reading.before: What they are promised is one uniformly punitive event.
changed_reading.after: The promised horizon is bifurcated by response: it opens hope along one trajectory and realizes threat along another, while destruction remains restricted to enacted departure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a meteorological branch is distant from the ordinary imperative, but it remains anchored in the focus patience root and in the nearby approaching-cloud and hastening sequence. Render it only as a secondary accumulation image, not as a lexical replacement for patience.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The patience imperative, the ban on acceleration, and the context's layered approaching weather event.

activation_trace.role: White cloud massed layer over layer supplies an image of accumulation before release.
An appearance advancing from one side gives the accumulated image a visible approach.
Cloud-borne water supplies the expected release of the gathered mass.
Punitive descent reverses the expected release and keeps accumulation morally unstable.
Acceleration supplies the attempt to force release before its meaning is known.

changed_reading.before: Patience is only an inward brake on emotion.
changed_reading.after: As a contained secondary image, patience also resembles allowing layers to gather until their proper release, while refusing to force an arrival whose apparent benefit may conceal reversal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the mortality branch is remote from the ordinary temporal sense of an hour, yet it is anchored in the same focus root and the nearby destruction clause, with eradication immediately modeled in context. Render it as a death-saturated echo inside temporal compression, never as the direct translation of the time expression.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The single hour, the immediate question about destruction, and the contextual eradication that leaves dwellings.

activation_trace.role: The branch naming the dead supplies a mortality resonance inside the compressed hour.
Collapse into death and loss makes that remote resonance locally consequential.
Eradication in the preceding narrative gives the mortality echo a concrete contextual counterpart.

changed_reading.before: The hour functions only as a small unit of remembered duration.
changed_reading.after: The hour can carry a contained mortality echo: at the endpoint, compressed duration and the fate of the destroyed briefly occupy the same lexical field.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material model is cross-domain and depends on a non-dominant split mapping for the rescue verb, so it must remain explicitly exploratory. It is still anchored by the focus shell-exit and collapse branches, while the context contributes protective covering and repair of a crooked fracture; render it as an analogy for recoverability, not morphology or doctrine.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The transgressor as shell-exiter and the restriction of collapse, read beside the context's offer of forgiveness and rescue.

activation_trace.role: A fruit leaving its shell supplies the breach from a protective form.
A covering that protects what it encloses supplies the first material of recovery.
The split mapped image of setting a crooked fracture supplies repair rather than mere escape.
Collapse and extinction supply what successful covering and repair would avert.

changed_reading.before: The final contrast permits only intact obedience or irreversible destruction.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory material analogy, shell-exit creates a breach that can still be covered and reset before collapse; the context's call to respond occupies that repair interval.

strongest_changes: Patience changed from passive waiting into disciplined custody of a message under a strict boundary between delivery and timing.
Seeing changed from first perception into late correction after an approaching threat had already been misread as relief.
The listening group showed that patience regulates sequence rather than speed: silence lasts through completion, then warning and response become urgent.
The final transgressor category changed from a static label into enacted departure after repeated opportunities for return, while promise split into hopeful and threatening fulfillment by trajectory.
summary.what_was_special: The context supplied two inverse motion patterns that the focus alone did not expose: opponents accelerate an arrival they misread, while receptive listeners wait for completion and then move promptly. Split mapped roots also kept countability, repair, and other secondary material readings live without displacing the ordinary syntax.
remaining_uncertainties: The isolated proclamation can mark delivered notice, reached endpoint, sufficient provision, or more than one of these at once.
The compressed stay may be psychological recollection, an ontological rescaling at exposure, or a narrower statement about worldly duration.
The approaching-cloud narrative strongly activates the final seeing and hastening language, but the final scene can still retain an independent end-time scope.
The stacked-cloud, mortality-hour, and fracture-repair models should remain qualified resonances rather than lexical substitutions.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Patience is active self-binding to a chosen course.** ص ب ر B001 is self-restraint from panic; ع ز م B001 is firm resolve by binding the heart to a matter and B004 is keeping to a chosen course. The comparison to resolute messengers and prohibition of haste place restraint inside sustained mission. I infer that resolve gives patience direction and patience gives resolve duration. `فاصبر` therefore means maintained governed action, not passive waiting.
2. **Haste is corrected by a reversal of perceived duration.** ع ج ل B001 is hastening and bringing forward; ل ب ث B001 is staying in a place and B002 is delay. The messenger must not pull the promised event forward, while its recipients will later judge their stay to have been only an hour of daylight (ن ه ر B002, day opening with light). I infer that final sight compresses the duration that present impatience expands. The ayah preserves objective waiting and retrospective brevity together.
3. **The whole sequence resolves into conveyed notice.** ب ل غ B002 is conveying a message, while B001 is reaching the limit. The isolated `بلاغ` follows warning, promise, sight, and compressed time. I infer that the surah’s communicative work reaches its assigned limit in delivery; realization is not the messenger’s task. `بلاغ` therefore reads simultaneously as conveyance and arrival at the boundary of responsibility.
4. **Destruction belongs to those who emerge beyond the boundary.** ه ل ك B001 is ruin and extinction; the accepted ف س ق B002 is the date emerging from its peel. The final restriction links ruin only to the `فاسقون`. I infer the peel as a material model of a containing norm and emergence as departure from it; this remains exploratory because the inventory preserves only that concrete branch. The close therefore echoes 46:20’s image of transgression as boundary-break.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: No later ayah follows. On the full-surah reread, the closing `بلاغ` gathered the descent of 46:2, the messenger’s limited role in 46:9 and 46:23, and the jinn’s relay in 46:29–31 into one completed chain of conveyance.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Messenger-patience is restraint held to a firmly chosen course.** Both `ٱصْبِرْ` and `صَبَرَ` activate ص ب ر B001, restraining the self from panic or blameworthy impulse; `ٱلْعَزْمِ` activates ع ز م B001, firm inward resolve, with B004 supplying adherence to a chosen road, and `ٱلرُّسُلِ` activates ر س ل B002, messengers and their message-bearing role. The packet commands patience by comparison with resolved messengers. I infer that patience is not passive waiting but the temporal form of resolve: the messenger keeps carrying the assigned message without letting pressure alter its course. The comparison extends 46:30’s confirming succession from books to message-bearing persons.

2. **The command against haste separates patient conveyance from control of arrival.** `تَسْتَعْجِل` activates ع ج ل B001, seeking something before its time or bringing it forward; `يَوْمَ` activates ي و م B003, the marked event-day, `يَرَوْنَ` activates ر ء ي B001, seeing, and `يُوعَدُونَ` activates و ع د B002, threat. The packet prohibits hastening and then locates seeing on the promised day, while the same ayah assigns the messenger patient endurance and complete conveyance. I infer that the source of the promise retains event-timing, whereas the messenger remains responsible for an unbroken delivery course. Haste would collapse those distinct roles.

3. **Final sight compresses the apparent duration that had made delay feel persuasive.** `لَمْ يَلْبَثُوا` activates ل ب ث B001, staying or abiding in a place, and `مِن نَهَارٍ` activates ن ه ر B002, the daylight period opened by light. The packet compares their remembered stay to only a small interval of a daylight span when they see the promise. I infer that fulfilled sight changes the scale by which prior duration is judged: the long interval available for denial is retrospectively experienced as brief. This temporal compression supports patience without making the warning indefinite.

4. **Complete conveyance leaves ruin attached only to the boundary-breaking community.** `بَلَاغٌ` activates ب ل غ B002, making a message reach its recipients, with B003 supplying sufficiency; `يُهْلَكُ` activates ه ل ك B001, falling into ruin, and `ٱلْقَوْمُ` activates ق و م B001, a constituted people. The packet’s only branch for `ٱلْفَاسِقُونَ` is ف س ق B002, a fresh date emerging from its peel; it does not itself state the moral application. I infer from that concrete exit the image of a people breaking beyond a containing boundary after the message has fully reached them. The close therefore places sufficiency on conveyance and ruin on persistent communal exit, not on any defect in delivery.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: No later ayah remains in the packet, so no later surprise could revise this closing reading. Its final relation therefore stands as the retrospective control: patient conveyance reaches sufficiency, event-timing remains unhurried, and ruin is attached to persistent boundary-exit after the message has arrived.

baseline.text: O hâlde kararlı elçilerin sabrettiği gibi sabret; onlar için acele etme. Vadedildikleri şeyi görecekleri gün, sanki gündüzün yalnızca bir saati kadar kalmış olacaklar. Bu bir bildiridir. Yoldan çıkan topluluktan başkası yok edilir mi?

findings.text: Sabır, edilgin bekleyiş değil, kalbi seçilmiş yola bağlayan kararlılığın zaman içindeki biçimidir; görev baskı altında da yön değiştirmeden sürdürülür.
Acele etmeme buyruğu, olayın zamanını yönetme yetkisini vaadin kaynağında bırakırken elçinin sorumluluğunu kesintisiz iletimle sınırlar.
Vaadin görülmesi, inkâr için uzun görünen geçmiş süreyi gündüzün küçük bir parçasına sıkıştırır; gerçekleşme, bekleyişin algılanan ölçeğini geriye dönük olarak değiştirir.
Bildiri, yalnızca mesaj aktarmayı değil, elçinin sorumluluğunun erişebileceği sınıra varıp yeterli hâle gelmesini de belirtir.
Yoldan çıkan topluluk, hurmanın kabuğundan çıkar gibi koruyucu sınırı terk etmiş ve bu çıkışın sonunda yok oluşa varmış görünür.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: Premature haste (`quranic:root_000987:B001/m01`); a shortcut or rapid path (`quranic:root_000987:B008/m01`); lingering or staying (`quranic:root_001339:B001/m01`); a measured duration (`quranic:root_001700:B002/m01`); the opening span of daylight (`quranic:root_001559:B002/m01`); an appointed time or place (`quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: `ولا تستعجل لهم`, `يوم يرون ما يوعدون`, and `كأنهم لم يلبثوا إلا ساعة من نهار` (46:35).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The demanded acceleration is undercut by retrospective compression: once the promise is present, the allegedly long delay appears as only a fragment of daylight.
